criteria.description: Every proposed unit uses specific screenplay evidence and does not replace source facts with a generic story summary or invented content.

Exactly one current unit is dependency-ready and binds exact source/reference roles, one primary creative uncertainty, a currently admitted operation, a ready operation-specific prompt/input, an observable AI artifact, acceptance and a downstream consumer. Independently unlocked identity, appearance, composition, scale, style, motion, performance, threat, sound and edit layers are not overloaded into one call. Later units are compact blocked transitions until upstream results are selected, and the operations either close every defining beat of the claimed deliverable or name the uncovered gap.
The operations make concrete visual, spatial, performance, motion, sound, or continuity decisions for the Rain Station material instead of restating production phases.

Candidate selection and repair are based on observable generated results; the proposed record is replayable from actual operation, prompt/reference inputs, returned asset, selection decision and downstream binding, while repairs preserve what works and change one major layer at a time.

The answer starts with the current call or exact blocker, has one clear production line and at most three compact nodes, and every statement is consumed by a call input, reference role, candidate acceptance, next call, project mutation, or material creator decision; treatment preambles, orphan analysis and duplicated explanation are absent.
